scientific_integrity: Exact forest count, binomial-to-Poisson approximation, and limiting distribution are proved in RESULT.md; finite checks are corroborative rather than proof of asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random mappings only; the r=n permutation case is separate; weak two-scale asymptotics, without a local limit theorem or a quantitative mixed-limit convergence rate; historical priority remains qualified.
title: Branch-free cycle vertices have a mixed Gaussian quarter-power fluctuation law in random mappings
